selected.rationale: Delay on unique-id is on the mandatory first call in compose-post; without client-side timeouts/circuit breakers, even a slow ID generator stalls every post request and propagates unbounded latency to nginx-thrift clients.
Post-storage is the required persistence for every post; a delay here keeps compose-post blocked and reveals missing timeout/retry defenses on the write path.

Killing post-storage removes the shared persistence for both compose-post writes and home-timeline reads; with no failover or recovery, it causes immediate availability loss of the core functionality.
Home-timeline update is a synchronous fan-out from compose-post; delay on this edge makes the whole post creation slow and exposes unbounded latency propagation in the fan-out.
User-timeline update is another synchronous fan-out dependency; a slow response blocks compose-post and demonstrates missing deadline/timeout controls on timeline writes.
Text processing is required for every post; delay in text service delays the entire compose-post request, showing that non-storage dependencies also lack timeout protection.
The home-timeline read path depends on post-storage; a delay here causes timeline reads to hang and exposes missing timeouts/retries on the read side.
Loss on the compose-post->home-timeline edge means a successfully created post may never reach followers' timelines; without retry or compensation, this creates silent inconsistency.
